//: EAS Build/Submit profiles. Requires an Expo account: run `eas login` then `eas init`,
which writes extra.eas.projectId into app.json — that value is account-owned and cannot
be invented here. Push notifications stay unmintable until it exists, since
The `development` profile is the one that matters first: Expo Go on Android dropped
remote push support in SDK 53, so lib/notifications.ts currently no-ops there on purpose.
A development build is the only way to exercise push on a real Android device.

env.//: A device on the LAN cannot reach the host's localhost — set this to the dev machine's LAN IP. The Android-emulator 10.0.2.2 rewrite in lib/api/client.ts does not help a real device.
